notes:
v1.0.41 - FPS BOOST RESTORED + settings/login cleanup.

1) FPS FIX (the big one): the launcher was FORCING a 60-120 FPS cap on
every launch (wrote maxFps into options.txt + passed -Dreimagined.maxfps
+ a mod watchdog re-applied it every 5s). A 1650 that easily did 290 FPS
was being throttled to ~100-120. The cap is GONE: fresh profiles and
balanced/high/turbo presets now use 260 (vanilla Unlimited), the cap is
only passed when a real cap exists (<260), and the in-game watchdog only
enforces when a cap is present. Also lowered Extended View defaults
(32->16, turbo 48->24) since ghost chunks still cost GPU draws, and
CaptureCompat no longer enumerates Windows processes on the game thread
every 10s. Bundled FPS Boost updated to 1.0.13 (auto-upgrades existing
profiles on next launch).

2) Settings cleanup: removed the explanatory banner about the 3-option
update prompt; removed the CurseForge proxy URL field from Advanced (the
proxy still works internally, pointing at the hosted backend); Danger
Zone actions (Clear Logs, Clean Release Reset) now ask for a SECOND
confirmation before doing anything destructive.

3) Login gate: without a logged-in Microsoft account only Home and
Settings are accessible - Play, Instances, Modpacks, Downloads, Mods
and Logs require login (expired sessions count as not logged in).
